Camouflaging may help autistic people fit in socially; however, it might also lead to poorer well-being. It has been suggested that autistic females camouflage more than autistic males. This article explored differences between males and females who have an autism diagnosis, have characteristics of autism but no diagnosis and those with few autistic characteristics. It is important to include these groups as camouflaging may make it more difficult to get an autism diagnosis and therefore make it less likely a person will receive support. We found that autistic women camouflaged more than all other groups. The group with few autistic characteristics (males and females) camouflaged the least. Loneliness was found to be a possible reason for camouflaging for the diagnosed autistic group only. In terms of outcomes related to camouflaging, it was found that those who camouflaged most had a lower quality of life; this was true of all groups. This tells us that there may be different reasons to camouflage, and different outcomes related to camouflaging for those with many characteristics of autism (including those with a diagnosis), and those with few. It is important that clinicians, teachers, parents and other stakeholders are aware of the negative outcomes associated with camouflaging so that more support can be provided for those who need it.

sheet.es: Si tu familiar autista se esfuerza mucho por «encajar» ocultando sus rasgos, ese esfuerzo puede tener un coste. Mañana puedes ofrecer espacios donde no tenga que disimular, preguntar con calma cómo se siente tras situaciones sociales y valorar que la soledad puede empujar a camuflarse. Recuerda que una persona que camufla puede tener más dificultades para obtener diagnóstico y apoyos. Este estudio comparó a adultos jóvenes con diagnóstico autista, con muchos rasgos autistas sin diagnóstico y con pocos rasgos: las mujeres autistas camuflaban más, y camuflar más se asoció con peor calidad de vida en todos los grupos. Es un estudio de asociación, no demuestra causa, y no describe a cada persona.
sheet.en: If your autistic family member works hard to “fit in” by hiding their traits, that effort may come at a cost. Tomorrow you could offer spaces where they don't need to mask, gently ask how they feel after social situations, and notice that loneliness may drive camouflaging. Someone who camouflages may also find it harder to get a diagnosis and support. This study compared young adults with an autism diagnosis, with many autistic traits but no diagnosis, and with few traits: autistic women camouflaged most, and more camouflaging was linked to lower quality of life in every group. It shows associations, not causes, and does not describe every person.
sheet.sv: Om din autistiska närstående anstränger sig mycket för att ”passa in” genom att dölja sina drag kan det ha ett pris. I morgon kan du erbjuda platser där hen inte behöver maskera, lugnt fråga hur hen mår efter sociala situationer och vara uppmärksam på att ensamhet kan driva kamouflering. Den som kamouflerar kan också få svårare att få diagnos och stöd. Studien jämförde unga vuxna med autismdiagnos, med många autistiska drag utan diagnos och med få drag: autistiska kvinnor kamouflerade mest, och mer kamouflering hängde ihop med lägre livskvalitet i alla grupper. Den visar samband, inte orsaker, och gäller inte varje person.

title: "Work WITH us": a Delphi study about improving eating disorder treatment for autistic women with anorexia nervosa.
authors: Field SL, Fox JRE, Jones CRG, Williams MO
abstract: Background There is an increased prevalence of anorexia nervosa (AN) in autistic women and this group has poorer treatment outcomes compared to non-autistic women with AN. However, there is little research into improving eating disorder treatment for autistic women. This study investigated how best to support autistic women with AN within eating disorder services. Method A three-stage Delphi study was conducted with 49 participants with relevant expertise as a researcher, clinician, or expert by experience. Results A total of 70 statements were generated, with 56 reaching consensus after the final round. Statements reaching consensus made recommendations for adaptations to treatment, staff training, and service organisation. Conclusions The results highlight the need to distinguish between autism- and AN-related difficulties, accommodate autistic traits such as sensory sensitivities and communication differences, and ensure the autistic voice is present in both the development and delivery of care. Future research should investigate the impact of these adaptations on outcomes. The applicability of these recommendations to autistic people with other eating disorders and of other genders needs to be investigated further.

sheet.es: Si acompañas a una mujer autista en tratamiento por anorexia, puedes pedir al equipo que distinga qué viene del autismo (por ejemplo, rutinas o sensibilidad a texturas) y qué de la anorexia, que adapte el entorno sensorial y la forma de comunicarse, y que ella participe en las decisiones sobre su cuidado. Lleva una lista breve de sus necesidades sensoriales y comunicativas a la próxima cita. Es un estudio Delphi: 49 personas expertas (investigadoras, clínicas y mujeres con experiencia propia) llegaron a consenso en 56 recomendaciones. Su límite: son opiniones expertas, aún no se ha comprobado si mejoran los resultados, ni si sirven para otros géneros u otros trastornos alimentarios.
sheet.en: If you support an autistic woman in treatment for anorexia, you can ask the team to separate what comes from being autistic (such as routines or texture sensitivity) from what comes from anorexia, to adapt the sensory environment and communication style, and to involve her in decisions about her care. Bring a short list of her sensory and communication needs to the next appointment. This was a Delphi study: 49 experts (researchers, clinicians and women with lived experience) reached consensus on 56 recommendations. Its limit: these are expert views; it has not yet been tested whether they improve outcomes, or whether they apply to other genders or other eating disorders.
sheet.sv: Om du stöttar en autistisk kvinna som får behandling för anorexi kan du be teamet skilja på vad som hör till autismen (till exempel rutiner eller känslighet för konsistenser) och vad som hör till anorexin, anpassa sensorisk miljö och kommunikation, och låta henne vara delaktig i beslut om sin vård. Ta med en kort lista över hennes sensoriska och kommunikativa behov till nästa besök. Detta var en Delphistudie: 49 experter (forskare, kliniker och kvinnor med egen erfarenhet) enades om 56 rekommendationer. Begränsning: det är expertåsikter, och det är ännu inte prövat om de förbättrar resultaten eller gäller andra kön och andra ätstörningar.

title: Autism Spectrum Disorder: Neurodevelopmental Risk Factors, Biological Mechanism, and Precision Therapy.
authors: Wang L, Wang B, Wu C, Wang J, Sun M
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a heterogeneous, behaviorally defined neurodevelopmental disorder. Over the past two decades, the prevalence of autism spectrum disorders has progressively increased, however, no clear diagnostic markers and specifically targeted medications for autism have emerged. As a result, neurobehavioral abnormalities, neurobiological alterations in ASD, and the development of novel ASD pharmacological therapy necessitate multidisciplinary collaboration. In this review, we discuss the development of multiple animal models of ASD to contribute to the disease mechanisms of ASD, as well as new studies from multiple disciplines to assess the behavioral pathology of ASD. In addition, we summarize and highlight the mechanistic advances regarding gene transcription, RNA and non-coding RNA translation, abnormal synaptic signaling pathways, epigenetic post-translational modifications, brain-gut axis, immune inflammation and neural loop abnormalities in autism to provide a theoretical basis for the next step of precision therapy. Furthermore, we review existing autism therapy tactics and limits and present challenges and opportunities for translating multidisciplinary knowledge of ASD into clinical practice.

sheet.es: Para mañana: esta revisión no cambia nada en el día a día. No existen todavía análisis biológicos que confirmen el autismo ni medicamentos dirigidos a él, así que conviene desconfiar de pruebas o productos que prometan «tratar la causa». Lo útil sigue siendo observar qué necesita tu hijo o familiar, adaptar el entorno y escuchar su forma de comunicarse. Evidencia: es una revisión narrativa que resume estudios de laboratorio, sobre todo con modelos animales, genética, intestino e inflamación; no participaron familias. Límites: son hipótesis biológicas tempranas, no recomendaciones prácticas, y usa un lenguaje de «trastorno» que no refleja la diversidad de las personas autistas.
sheet.en: For tomorrow: this review changes nothing in daily life. There are still no biological tests that confirm autism and no medicines targeting it, so be cautious about tests or products promising to “treat the cause.” What helps remains noticing what your child or relative needs, adapting the environment and respecting how they communicate. Evidence: this is a narrative review summarising laboratory research, mostly animal models, genetics, the gut and inflammation; no families took part. Limits: these are early biological hypotheses, not practical guidance, and the paper uses deficit-based “disorder” language that does not reflect the diversity of autistic people.
sheet.sv: Inför i morgon: den här översikten ändrar inget i vardagen. Det finns fortfarande inga biologiska tester som bekräftar autism och inga läkemedel riktade mot autism, så var försiktig med tester eller produkter som lovar att ”behandla orsaken”. Det som hjälper är fortfarande att se vad ditt barn eller din anhörige behöver, anpassa miljön och respektera hur hen kommunicerar. Evidens: en narrativ översikt som sammanfattar laboratorieforskning, främst djurmodeller, genetik, tarm och inflammation; inga familjer deltog. Begränsningar: det rör sig om tidiga biologiska hypoteser, inte praktiska råd, och texten använder ett bristfokuserat ”störnings”-språk som inte speglar autistiska människors mångfald.

title: Effects of Equine-Assisted Activities and Therapies for Individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
authors: Xiao N, Shinwari K, Kiselev S, Huang X, Li B, Qi J
journal: International journal of environmental research and public health
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) has become a critical public health issue that affects more than 78 million people. In many recent studies, the authors have demonstrated that equine-assisted activities and therapies (EAATs) can substantially improve the social and behavioral skills of children with ASD. However, the qualities of the studies differ, and some authors reached opposite conclusions. In this review, we systematically and objectively examined the effectiveness of EAATs for people with ASD, combining both qualitative and quantitative methods. We searched five databases (PubMed, Scopus, ERIC, ProQuest, and MEDLINE) and added relevant references, and we identified 25 articles for data extraction and analysis. According to our results, EAAT programs can substantially improve the social and behavioral functioning and language abilities of children with ASD. However, among the subdomains, the results were inconsistent. According to the meta-analyses, there were considerable improvements in the social cognition, communication, irritability, and hyperactivity domains, but not in the domains of social awareness, mannerisms, motivation, lethargy, stereotypy, or inappropriate speech. Moreover, there was a lack of sufficient comparative data to conclude that EAAT programs lead to substantial improvements in motor and sensory functioning. In addition, among the included studies, we noted the indicator of whether EAAT programs decreased parental stress and improved family functioning, and although there were four articles in which the researchers considered this aspect, we were unable to draw any conclusions because of the insufficient data and conflicting descriptive evidence. However, we need to consider the improvement in parental mental health as a factor in the effectiveness of this complementary intervention. We hope that in future studies, researchers will focus on family functioning and conduct more randomized controlled trials (RCTs) with blinded assessments using different scales and measures.

sheet.es: Si a tu hijo o hija le atraen los caballos y disfruta del entorno, las actividades asistidas con caballos pueden ser una opción complementaria que valga la pena probar, observando con calma si le resultan agradables y útiles para comunicarse y relacionarse. No sustituyen otros apoyos. Esta revisión sistemática con metaanálisis reunió 25 estudios, sobre todo con niños autistas, y encontró mejoras en comunicación, cognición social, irritabilidad e hiperactividad, pero no en otras áreas como la motivación o el movimiento. Sus límites: los estudios eran de calidad desigual, había pocos ensayos controlados y cegados, y no hubo datos suficientes sobre el estrés familiar. Lo que funciona para unos puede no servir para otros.
sheet.en: If your child is drawn to horses and enjoys being around them, equine-assisted activities may be a complementary option worth trying. Calmly notice whether the sessions feel pleasant and support communication and connection. They do not replace other support. This systematic review and meta-analysis pooled 25 studies, mostly with autistic children, and found improvements in communication, social cognition, irritability and hyperactivity, but not in areas such as motivation, repetitive movements or motor skills. Its limits: study quality varied, there were few blinded randomized trials, and there was too little data on family stress. What helps one child may not help another.
sheet.sv: Om ditt barn dras till hästar och trivs i stallmiljön kan hästunderstödda aktiviteter vara ett kompletterande alternativ att prova. Märk lugnt om passen känns trivsamma och stöttar kommunikation och samspel. De ersätter inte annat stöd. Denna systematiska översikt med metaanalys sammanställde 25 studier, mest med autistiska barn, och fann förbättringar i kommunikation, social kognition, irritabilitet och hyperaktivitet, men inte inom områden som motivation, upprepade rörelser eller motorik. Begränsningar: studiernas kvalitet varierade, det fanns få blindade randomiserade studier och för lite data om stress i familjen. Det som hjälper ett barn hjälper inte nödvändigtvis ett annat.

title: The global prevalence of autism spectrum disorder: A three-level meta-analysis.
authors: Talantseva OI, Romanova RS, Shurdova EM, Dolgorukova TA, Sologub PS, Titova OS, Kleeva DF, Grigorenko EL
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is one the most disabling developmental disorders, imposing an extremely high economic burden. Obtaining as accurate prevalence estimates as possible is crucial to guide governments in planning policies for identification and intervention for individuals with ASD and their relatives. The precision of prevalence estimates can be heightened by summative analyses of the data collected around the world. To that end, we conducted a three-level mixed-effects meta-analysis. A systematic search of the Web of Science, PubMed, EMBASE, and PsycINFO databases from 2000 up to 13 July 2020 was performed, and reference lists of previous reviews and existing databases of prevalence studies were screened. Overall, 79 studies were included in the analysis of ASD and 59-in the analysis of previously existing relevant diagnoses: 30 for Autistic Disorder (AD), 15 for Asperger Syndrome (AS), and 14 for Atypical Autism (AA) and Pervasive Developmental Disorder - Not Otherwise Specified (PDD-NOS); these research reports covered the period from 1994 to 2019. Pooled prevalence estimates were 0.72% (95% CI = 0.61-0.85) for ASD, 0.25% (95% CI = 0.18-0.33) for AD, 0.13% (95% CI = 0.07-0.20) for AS, and 0.18% (95% CI = 0.10-0.28) for the combined group of AA and PDD-NOS. Estimates were higher (1) for the studies that used records-review surveillance rather than other designs; (2) in North America compared with other geographical regions; and (3) in high-income compared with lower-income countries. The highest prevalence estimates were registered in the USA. There was an increase in autism prevalence estimates over time. The prevalence was also significantly higher for children aged between 6 and 12 years compared to children under the age of 5 and over the age of 13 years. Systematic review registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/prospero/display_record.php?ID=CRD42019131525, identifier CRD42019131525.

sheet.es: Si tu hijo o hija es autista, no estáis solos: este estudio estima que alrededor de 7 de cada 1.000 personas son autistas en el mundo, y las cifras suben cuando hay más servicios y más búsqueda activa. Que en tu entorno se diagnostique menos no significa que haya menos personas autistas; puede indicar falta de acceso. Si sospechas que tu familia necesita una evaluación o apoyos, vale la pena pedirlos, sobre todo en la etapa escolar. Es un metaanálisis de 79 estudios de muchos países (1994–2019). Sus límites: los estudios usan métodos muy distintos, hay pocos datos de países de ingresos bajos y de personas adultas.
sheet.en: If your child is autistic, you are far from alone: this study estimates that about 7 in 1,000 people worldwide are autistic, and figures rise where there are more services and more active searching. Fewer diagnoses where you live do not mean fewer autistic people; they may signal limited access. If you think your family could use an assessment or support, it is reasonable to ask, especially during the school years. This is a meta-analysis of 79 studies from many countries (1994–2019). Its limits: the studies used very different methods, and there is little data from lower-income countries or on autistic adults.
sheet.sv: Om ditt barn är autistiskt är ni långt ifrån ensamma: studien uppskattar att ungefär 7 av 1 000 människor i världen är autistiska, och siffrorna är högre där det finns mer stöd och fler som letar aktivt. Färre diagnoser där du bor betyder inte färre autistiska personer; det kan tyda på sämre tillgång till utredning. Om du tror att familjen behöver utredning eller stöd är det rimligt att be om det, särskilt under skolåren. Detta är en metaanalys av 79 studier från många länder (1994–2019). Begränsningar: studierna använde mycket olika metoder, och det finns lite data från låginkomstländer och om autistiska vuxna.

title: Comprehensive ABA-based interventions in the treatment of children with autism spectrum disorder - a meta-analysis.
authors: Eckes T, Buhlmann U, Holling HD, Möllmann A
abstract: Background Many studies display promising results for interventions that are based on Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) in the treatment of autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Methods This meta-analysis assessed the effects of such treatments on developmental outcomes in children with ASD and on parental stress based on 11 studies with 632 participants. Results Compared to treatment as usual, minimal or no treatment, comprehensive ABA-based interventions showed medium effects for intellectual functioning (standardized mean difference SMD = 0.51, 95% CI [0.09; 0.92]) and adaptive behavior (SMD = 0.37, 95% CI [0.03; 0.70]). Language abilities, symptom severity or parental stress did not improve beyond the improvement in control groups. Moderator analyses indicate that language abilities at intake could influence the effect sizes and the influence of treatment intensity might decrease with older age. Conclusions Practical implications and limitations are discussed.

sheet.es: Si tu familia está valorando un programa intensivo basado en ABA, este estudio sugiere que puede ayudar algo en habilidades cognitivas y de la vida diaria, pero no mostró más avances que otras opciones en lenguaje ni en el estrés de los padres. Merece la pena preguntar cómo se adapta a tu hijo o hija, si respeta su bienestar y cómo se mide el progreso. Es un metaanálisis de 11 estudios con 632 niños y niñas autistas. Sus límites: pocos estudios, resultados variables y no midió la calidad de vida ni la opinión de las propias personas autistas, así que no es una regla para todos.
sheet.en: If your family is considering an intensive ABA-based programme, this study suggests it may help somewhat with thinking skills and everyday living skills, but it did not show more progress than other options in language or parental stress. It is worth asking how a programme adapts to your child, whether it respects their wellbeing, and how progress is measured. This is a meta-analysis of 11 studies with 632 autistic children. Its limits: few studies, varied results, and it did not measure quality of life or autistic people's own views, so it is not a rule for every child.
sheet.sv: Om er familj funderar på ett intensivt ABA-baserat program tyder studien på att det kan hjälpa något för tankeförmåga och vardagsfärdigheter, men det visade inte större framsteg än andra alternativ för språk eller föräldrars stress. Det är värt att fråga hur programmet anpassas efter ditt barn, om det respekterar barnets välmående och hur framsteg mäts. Detta är en metaanalys av 11 studier med 632 autistiska barn. Begränsningar: få studier, varierande resultat och varken livskvalitet eller autistiska personers egna perspektiv mättes, så den är ingen regel för alla barn.
